limits: Only the complete direct RegExp Symbol.split and Symbol.species directories are selected, not all RegExp tests.
All 8006 older case objects, 2144 controls, source fingerprints and policies are identical.
The new selection gains 86 passes; two failures now expose missing Date.now and six remain unsupported for realms or Unicode regexp parsing.
The local Array.prototype indexed-accessor prerequisite remains unsupported in its two original modes.
Unicode regexp parsing, realms, Date, other RegExp symbol methods and complete RegExp constructor conversion remain incomplete.
The existing default RegExp constructor still does not implement all Symbol.match-classified pattern-like objects.
Resource-observation profiles retain their earlier results and are not promoted to healthy gates.
Tests and local self-review do not establish complete allocation accounting or independently audited security.
